title: Databricks Personal access token: one-property twin (length)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 31-byte body vs the 32 characters Microsoft Purview's Azure Databricks personal access token definition fixes (learn.microsoft.com: "A combination of 32 characters"). Twin of "Databricks Personal access token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
